  <!-- MANUAL VS AUTOMATED -->
  <div class="scale-comparison">
    <div class="scale-comparison-item">
      <span class="scale-comparison-number">01</span>
      <div>
        <h3>Manual Scaling</h3>
        <p>More brands and markets create more localization, resizing, copy adaptation, and specification work. Human production becomes the bottleneck.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-comparison-arrow">&rarr;</div>

    <div class="scale-comparison-item scale-comparison-highlight">
      <span class="scale-comparison-number">02</span>
      <div>
        <h3>Automated Scaling</h3>
        <p>The platform performs repetitive production work. Humans stay in the loop for creative judgment, exceptions, brand quality, and final approval.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const root = document.getElementById("scale-stress-test");
      if (!root) return;

      const CONFIG = {
        pilotGain: 60,
        maxBrands: 50,
        maxMarkets: 20,
        variationsPerPair: 4,
        formatsPerVariation: 3,
        maximumErosion: 45
      };

      const brandsInput = root.querySelector("#scale-brands");
      const marketsInput = root.querySelector("#scale-markets");
      const automationInput = root.querySelector("#scale-automation");

      const brandValue = root.querySelector("#scale-brand-value");
      const marketValue = root.querySelector("#scale-market-value");
      const automationValue = root.querySelector("#scale-automation-value");

      const pairsElement = root.querySelector("#scale-pairs");
      const deliverablesElement = root.querySelector("#scale-deliverables");
      const manualElement = root.querySelector("#scale-manual");

      const retainedElement = root.querySelector("#scale-retained");
      const retainedSmallElement = root.querySelector("#scale-retained-small");
      const retainedBar = root.querySelector("#scale-retained-bar");
      const messageElement = root.querySelector("#scale-message");

      const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US");

      function calculateModel() {
        const brands = Number(brandsInput.value);
        const markets = Number(marketsInput.value);
        const automation = Number(automationInput.value);

        const pairs = brands * markets;
        const deliverables = pairs * CONFIG.variationsPerPair * CONFIG.formatsPerVariation;
        const manualShare = 1 - (automation / 100);
        const manualAdaptations = Math.round(deliverables * manualShare);

        const maximumPairs = CONFIG.maxBrands * CONFIG.maxMarkets;
        const scalePressure = Math.log10(Math.max(1, pairs)) / Math.log10(maximumPairs);

        const erosion = CONFIG.maximumErosion * scalePressure * manualShare;
        const retainedGain = Math.max(
          CONFIG.pilotGain - CONFIG.maximumErosion,
          Math.min(CONFIG.pilotGain, CONFIG.pilotGain - erosion)
        );

        return {
          brands,
          markets,
          automation,
          pairs,
          deliverables,
          manualAdaptations,
          retainedGain
        };
      }

      function updateInterface() {
        const data = calculateModel();
        const retained = Math.round(data.retainedGain);

        brandValue.textContent = data.brands;
        marketValue.textContent = data.markets;
        automationValue.textContent = data.automation + "%";

        pairsElement.textContent = formatter.format(data.pairs);
        deliverablesElement.textContent = formatter.format(data.deliverables);
        manualElement.textContent = formatter.format(data.manualAdaptations);

        retainedElement.textContent = retained + "%";
        retainedSmallElement.textContent = retained + "%";
        retainedBar.style.width = retained + "%";

        if (data.pairs <= 4) {
          messageElement.textContent =
            "At pilot-like scale, the original 60% improvement is largely protected because the manual workload remains small.";
        } else if (data.automation >= 75) {
          messageElement.textContent =
            `At ${data.brands} brands × ${data.markets} markets, automating ${data.automation}% of repetitive adaptation preserves most of the pilot gain while keeping humans focused on creative review and exceptions.`;
        } else if (data.automation >= 40) {
          messageElement.textContent =
            `At ${data.brands} brands × ${data.markets} markets, the growing manual workload begins to consume the pilot advantage. More automation is required to preserve the original 60% improvement.`;
        } else {
          messageElement.textContent =
            `At ${data.brands} brands × ${data.markets} markets, scaling primarily through human production creates a major bottleneck. The pilot worked, but its efficiency advantage cannot scale with the workload.`;
        }
      }

      brandsInput.addEventListener("input", updateInterface);
      marketsInput.addEventListener("input", updateInterface);
      automationInput.addEventListener("input", updateInterface);

      updateInterface();
    })();
  </script>
</section>

<!-- PLAN -->
<section id="plan">
  <p class="eyebrow">Transformation Roadmap</p>
  <h2>Six-Month Transformation Plan</h2>
  <p class="sub">From Successful Pilot to Scalable Global Operations</p>
  <div class="plan">
    <div class="phase">
      <p class="mo">Month 1</p><h4>1. Discover and Standardize</h4>
      <ul><li>Audit existing brand assets and workflows</li><li>Define the metadata schema and naming conventions</li><li>Inventory style guides, design systems, SKUs, templates, and sample ads</li><li>Establish measurable pilot and business-success criteria</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase alt">
      <p class="mo">Month 2</p><h4>2. Build the Data Foundation</h4>
      <ul><li>Organize approved assets within the DAM</li><li>Connect product and SKU data from the PIM</li><li>Create reusable JSON brand-and-market profiles</li><li>Define permissions, governance rules, and approval requirements</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase">
      <p class="mo">Month 3</p><h4>3. Develop the MVP</h4>
      <ul><li>Build the DAM-to-ad-generation pipeline</li><li>Develop a role-based user interface</li><li>Generate new assets using approved brand components</li><li>Add automated localization and specification checks</li><li>Route outputs into human review</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase alt">
      <p class="mo">Month 4</p><h4>4. Test and Validate</h4>
      <ul><li>Bring creative, market, IT, and operations stakeholders together</li><li>Conduct integration, brand-quality, and localization testing</li><li>Run first-round QA and error analysis</li><li>Refine workflows based on stakeholder feedback</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase wave">
      <span class="flag">Wave 1</span>
      <p class="mo">Month 5</p><h4>5. Launch a Controlled Wave</h4>
      <ul><li>Roll out to three representative brands in two markets</li><li>Test in real campaign conditions</li><li>Train local teams and establish support resources</li><li>Track adoption, quality, cycle time, and first-pass approval</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase alt">
      <p class="mo">Month 6</p><h4>6. Handoff and Scale</h4>
      <ul><li>Transfer system ownership to internal stakeholders</li><li>Assign operational, governance, and technical roles</li><li>Deliver documentation, training, and support procedures</li><li>Establish ROI reporting and continuous improvement</li><li>Prepare the next group of brands and markets for rollout</li></ul>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tracks">
    <div class="track"><b>Automation discovery embedded at every stage</b><div class="span"></div></div>
    <div class="track"><b>Stakeholder alignment, change management &amp; training</b><div class="span"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="note-added">
    <b>Wave 1 selection criteria &mdash; why these three brands, these two markets</b>
    <ul>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">One flagship, high-volume brand</b> &mdash; proves the system at real campaign pressure, where the ROI is largest.</li>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">One mid-tail brand</b> &mdash; represents the long tail where 40+ of the 50 brands actually live; validates self-serve economics.</li>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">One deliberately hard case</b> &mdash; a brand with strict guidelines or legacy asset debt, so Wave 1 earns credibility rather than an easy win.</li>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">Markets: one Western anchor + Japan</b> &mdash; Japan stress-tests the localization engine (idiom transcreation, vertical setting, distinct legal footers) and puts the local team in the pilot as owners, not recipients.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- SOLUTION -->
<section id="solution">
<div id="workflow-app" class="workflow-root">
  <style>
    #workflow-app{--ink:#16231d;--green:#173f32;--green2:#315c4b;--paper:#fbfbf8;--line:#b9c1bb;--soft:#eff2ee;--gold:#b97a0c;--goldbg:#fff4db;--muted:#606963;background:light-dark(#fbfbf8,#111814);color:light-dark(#16231d,#eef4ef);font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;padding:22px 24px;border-radius:0;min-width:0}
    #workflow-app *{box-sizing:border-box}
    #workflow-app .eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:light-dark(#315c4b,#a7c5b6);margin-bottom:6px}
    #workflow-app h1{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(26px,3.6vw,42px);line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 10px;max-width:960px}
    #workflow-app .sub{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;color:light-dark(#315c4b,#b7d0c3);margin-bottom:20px;font-size:15px}
    #workflow-app .layout{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
    #workflow-app .cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;width:100%}
    
    /* Base Step Card */
    #workflow-app .step{position:relative;min-width:0;background:light-dark(#fbfbf8,#18211c);padding:38px 12px 12px;min-height:150px;text-align:left;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s ease,background .2s ease,transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
    #workflow-app .step:focus-visible{outline:3px solid light-dark(#315c4b,#93b8a5);outline-offset:3px}
    
    /* Category 1: Automated / Collaborative / Assisted (Dark Green) */
    #workflow-app .step.auto{border:1px solid light-dark(#6b8275,#41554a)}
    #workflow-app .step.auto .num{background:var(--green)}
    #workflow-app .step.auto .explore{color:light-dark(#244437,#a7c7b7)}
    @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
      #workflow-app .step.auto:hover{
        border-color:var(--green);
        transform:translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow:0 8px 24px -2px rgba(23,63,50,0.28), 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(23,63,50,0.35);
      }
    }
    #workflow-app .step.auto.active{border-color:var(--green);box-shadow:0 6px 20px -2px rgba(23,63,50,0.25), 0 0 0 2px light-dark(#173f32,#9fc5b1);background:light-dark(#f4f7f4,#1d2a23)}

    /* Category 2: Human Review Gate (Amber / Gold) */
    #workflow-app .step.human{border:1.5px solid var(--gold);background:light-dark(#fffcf3,#231d14)}
    #workflow-app .step.human .num{background:var(--gold)}
    #workflow-app .step.human .explore{color:light-dark(#855708,#e0b666)}
    @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
      #workflow-app .step.human:hover{
        border-color:var(--gold);
        transform:translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow:0 8px 24px -2px rgba(185,122,12,0.32), 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(185,122,12,0.45);
      }
    }
    #workflow-app .step.human.active{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 6px 20px -2px rgba(185,122,12,0.3), 0 0 0 2px var(--gold);background:light-dark(#fff9ea,#2b2418)}

    /* Step Card Content */
    #workflow-app .num{position:absolute;left:10px;top:-13px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;min-width:28px;height:28px;padding:0 8px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
    
    /* Stakeholder Tags Color Alignment */
    #workflow-app .owner{position:absolute;right:8px;top:0;transform:translateY(-48%);border:1px solid light-dark(#4d6d5d,#799587);background:light-dark(#fbfbf8,#18211c);color:light-dark(#315c4b,#b7d0c3);font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 7px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:700}
    #workflow-app .owner.ops{border-color:#0d655f;color:#0d655f;background:light-dark(#f0f7f6,#162422)}
    #workflow-app .owner.it{border-color:#475569;color:#475569;background:light-dark(#f1f5f9,#1a222a)}
    #workflow-app .owner.creative{border-color:#1b4332;color:#1b4332;background:light-dark(#edf6f1,#192620)}
    #workflow-app .owner.market{border-color:#b45309;color:#b45309;background:light-dark(#fef8eb,#272015)}
    #workflow-app .owner.human{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);background:light-dark(#fff9ea,#292215)}
    #workflow-app .owner.leadership{border-color:#1e3a8a;color:#1e3a8a;background:light-dark(#f0f4fa,#182230)}

    #workflow-app .step h2{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:16px;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 7px;color:light-dark(#16231d,#eef4ef)}
    #workflow-app .step p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:12.8px;line-height:1.38;margin:0;color:light-dark(#222f28,#dbe3df)}
    #workflow-app .explore{display:block;margin-top:10px;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}

    /* Single Status Legend */
    #workflow-app .legend{display:flex;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-top:2px;font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:light-dark(#4e5852,#b1bbb5)}
    #workflow-app .key{display:inline-flex;gap:7px;align-items:center}
    #workflow-app .swatch{width:11px;height:11px;border:1px solid #55625a;background:transparent}
    #workflow-app .swatch.auto{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green)}
    #workflow-app .swatch.human{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold)}
    
    /* Compact Drawer styling with dynamic row heights */
    #workflow-app .drawer{border:1px solid light-dark(#c3cac5,#39433d);border-top:3.5px solid var(--green);background:light-dark(#f4f6f3,#151d18);padding:14px 20px;width:100%;margin-top:10px;display:none}
    #workflow-app .drawer.open{display:block}
    #workflow-app .drawer-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid light-dark(#c9d0cb,#3d4741);padding-bottom:10px;margin-bottom:10px}
    #workflow-app .drawer-num{background:var(--green);color:#fff;font-weight:800;width:30px;height:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:0 0 auto;font-size:15px}
    #workflow-app .drawer-title-wrap{flex:1;min-width:0}.drawer-title{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:20px;font-style:italic;font-weight:700;margin:0 0 2px}
    #workflow-app .drawer-owner{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;color:light-dark(#315c4b,#abc4b7)}
    #workflow-app .drawer-owner.ops{color:#0d655f}
    #workflow-app .drawer-owner.it{color:#475569}
    #workflow-app .drawer-owner.creative{color:#1b4332}
    #workflow-app .drawer-owner.market{color:#b45309}
    #workflow-app .drawer-owner.human{color:var(--gold)}
    #workflow-app .drawer-owner.leadership{color:#1e3a8a}
    #workflow-app .close{border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font-size:22px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.close:hover{background:light-dark(#e6eae6,#243029)}
    
    /* 5-Row Layout (height tightly controlled by text content) */
    #workflow-app .drawer-rows{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
    #workflow-app .drawer-row{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid light-dark(#e3e8e4,#26332b)}
    #workflow-app .drawer-row:first-child{padding-top:0}
    #workflow-app .drawer-row:last-child{border-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
    #workflow-app .drawer-row h3{font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 3px;color:light-dark(#315c4b,#aec6ba);line-height:1.2}
    #workflow-app .drawer-row p{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4;margin:0}
    #workflow-app ul{padding-left:18px;margin:2px 0 0}
    #workflow-app li{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;margin:2px 0}
    #workflow-app .io{display:inline-grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(130px,260px) auto minmax(130px,260px);gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:2px}
    #workflow-app .io-box{border:1px solid light-dark(#9aa59e,#4c5851);padding:6px 10px;background:light-dark(#fbfbf8,#1b251f);min-height:0}
    #workflow-app .io-label{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:light-dark(#5b665f,#a8b5ae);margin-bottom:2px}
    #workflow-app .io-value{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;line-height:1.2}
    #workflow-app .io-arrow{font-size:18px;color:light-dark(#315c4b,#abc5b7);text-align:center}
    #workflow-app .flow{margin-top:4px;font-size:11px;line-height:1.3;color:light-dark(#56625b,#aab6af);font-family:Arial,sans-serif}
    #workflow-app .analogs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:2px}
    #workflow-app .analog{border:1px solid light-dark(#7d8a82,#59665e);background:light-dark(#fbfbf8,#1b251f);color:inherit;padding:4px 10px;font-size:10.5px;cursor:pointer;min-height:26px}
    #workflow-app .analog.selected{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);color:#fff}
    #workflow-app .analog-detail{margin-top:5px;border-left:3px solid light-dark(#315c4b,#8fb29f);padding:7px 11px;background:light-dark(#eaf0eb,#202b24);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:13px;line-height:1.38}
    #workflow-app .case-badge{display:inline-block;margin-bottom:3px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:8.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:light-dark(#315c4b,#b7d0c3)}
    #workflow-app .case-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:5px;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:9.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.07em;text-transform:uppercase;color:light-dark(#173f32,#b7d0c3);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
    #workflow-app .why{border-left:3.5px solid var(--green);padding:8px 12px;background:light-dark(#edf2ee,#1f2a23);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;margin-top:2px}
    #workflow-app .mobile-hint{display:none}

    /* Category Theming in Drawer */
    #workflow-app .drawer.auto{border-top:3.5px solid var(--green)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.auto .drawer-num{background:var(--green);color:#fff}

    #workflow-app .drawer.human{background:light-dark(#fff9ea,#2b2418);border-color:light-dark(#dfcb9e,#4a3c26);border-top:3.5px solid var(--gold)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .drawer-head{border-bottom-color:light-dark(#dfcb9e,#4a3c26)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .drawer-num{background:var(--gold);color:#fff}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .drawer-row{border-bottom-color:light-dark(#eddcb6,#3f331f)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .drawer-row h3{color:light-dark(#9a6709,#d8ac57)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .why{border-left-color:var(--gold);background:light-dark(#fff2d2,#392d1a)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .io-box{background:light-dark(#fffdf7,#241d13);border-color:light-dark(#d5c39c,#4a3c26)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .io-arrow{color:var(--gold)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .analog{background:light-dark(#fffdf7,#241d13);border-color:light-dark(#d5c39c,#4a3c26)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .analog.selected{background:var(--gold);border-color:var(--gold);color:#fff}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .analog-detail{border-left-color:var(--gold);background:light-dark(#fff2d2,#392d1a)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .case-badge{color:light-dark(#9a6709,#d8ac57)}
    #workflow-app .drawer.human .case-link{color:light-dark(#7a5105,#e0b666)}
    
    @media(max-width:960px){
      #workflow-app .cards{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
    }
    @media(max-width:620px){
      #workflow-app{padding:14px 10px}
      #workflow-app .cards{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}
      #workflow-app .drawer.open{padding:12px 10px}
      #workflow-app .owner{max-width:62%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
      #workflow-app .mobile-hint{display:block;font-size:11px;color:light-dark(#5c665f,#a9b4ad);margin-bottom:12px}
      #workflow-app .io{grid-template-columns:1fr;width:100%}
      #workflow-app .io-arrow{transform:rotate(90deg);text-align:center}
    }
  </style>

  <div class="eyebrow">Co-Innovation Solution</div>
  <h1>Automated Localization &amp; Spec Compliance, Connected to the Legacy DAM</h1>
  <div class="sub">Step by Step — every stage co-built with the team that owns it</div>
  <div class="mobile-hint">Tap any step to explore the underlying workflow.</div>

  <div class="layout" id="layout">
    <div class="cards" id="cards" aria-label="Eight-step automation workflow"></div>
    
    <div class="legend">
      <span class="key"><span class="swatch auto"></span> Automated step / Collaborative / Assisted</span>
      <span class="key"><span class="swatch human"></span> Human review gate</span>
    </div>

    <aside class="drawer" id="drawer" aria-live="polite" aria-label="Step details">
      <div class="drawer-head">
        <div class="drawer-num" id="drawerNum">1</div>
        <div class="drawer-title-wrap">
          <div class="drawer-title" id="drawerTitle"></div>
          <div class="drawer-owner" id="drawerOwner"></div>
        </div>
        <button class="close" id="closeDrawer" type="button" aria-label="Close details">×</button>
      </div>

      <div class="drawer-rows">
        <!-- Row 1: Purpose -->
        <section class="drawer-row">
          <h3>Purpose</h3>
          <p id="purpose"></p>
        </section>

        <!-- Row 2: What Happens -->
        <section class="drawer-row">
          <h3>What Happens</h3>
          <ul id="happens"></ul>
        </section>

        <!-- Row 3: INPUT → OUTPUT -->
        <section class="drawer-row">
          <h3>Input → Output</h3>
          <div class="io">
            <div class="io-box"><div class="io-label">Input</div><div class="io-value" id="input"></div></div>
            <div class="io-arrow">→</div>
            <div class="io-box"><div class="io-label">Output</div><div class="io-value" id="output"></div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="flow" id="flow"></div>
        </section>

        <!-- Row 4: Documented Enterprise Case Studies -->
        <section class="drawer-row">
          <h3>Documented Enterprise Case Studies</h3>
          <div class="analogs" id="analogs"></div>
          <div class="analog-detail" id="analogDetail"></div>
        </section>

        <!-- Row 5: Why It Matters -->
        <section class="drawer-row">
          <h3>Why It Matters</h3>
          <div class="why" id="why"></div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </div>

  <script>
    (()=>{
      const root=document.getElementById('workflow-app');
      if(root.dataset.ready==='1') return;
      root.dataset.ready='1';

      const data=[
        {n:1,category:'auto',role:'ops',owner:'With Content Ops',title:'Ingest the Campaign Brief',short:'One JSON brief defines brand, markets, formats, audiences, and message — the contract for everything downstream.',purpose:'Convert a human marketing request into a structured, machine-readable production contract.',items:['Validate brand, market, audience, product, channel and due-date fields.','Normalize naming and taxonomy so downstream systems receive consistent values.','Assign a campaign/job ID and resolve the rules that apply to each market and format.','Calculate the required outputs before production begins.'],input:'Campaign brief / JSON',output:'Campaign manifest',flow:'Campaign requirements → structured job definition → downstream production rules',why:'The brief becomes executable data rather than a set of instructions that every production team has to reinterpret.',analogs:[['Coca-Cola','Adobe documents Coca-Cola using Workfront intake forms and standardized workflows to capture project information, automatically create projects, and coordinate global, operating-unit, and market execution.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2025/sessions/cocacola-crafting-a-techaugmented-marketing-s807.html']]},
        {n:2,category:'auto',role:'it',owner:'With IT / Engineering',title:'Sync the Legacy DAM',short:'Read-only pull of approved assets, tagged by role and SHA-256 fingerprint. The DAM stays the system of record.',purpose:'Connect the automation layer to existing approved content without replacing the organization’s DAM.',items:['Query the DAM through APIs using campaign and product metadata.','Retrieve approved asset IDs, versions, rights and usage status.','Map legacy taxonomy into the automation workflow.','Use asset identity and version information to detect changes and avoid duplicates.'],input:'Campaign manifest',output:'Approved asset manifest',flow:'Campaign manifest → DAM API + metadata matching → approved source assets',why:'Existing approved assets are reused first, while the DAM remains authoritative and no new content silo is created.',analogs:[['Genpact','Adobe documents Genpact connecting Workfront-driven content workflows with AEM Assets so teams can work from governed, approved enterprise assets rather than recreate content in separate silos.','https://business.adobe.com/customer-success-stories/genpact.html']]},
        {n:3,category:'auto',role:'creative',owner:'With Brand Standards',title:'Resolve Missing Assets',short:'Gaps are generated with approved services from approved components — provenance flag and human-review marker on.',purpose:'Perform an asset coverage check and create or request only what the campaign is missing.',items:['Compare required campaign components with the approved asset manifest.','Reuse existing assets wherever possible.','Generate eligible missing backgrounds, crops or treatments from approved components.','Flag generated material with provenance and review metadata.','Route non-generatable gaps to the appropriate production owner.'],input:'Approved asset manifest',output:'Complete component set',flow:'Required components − available components = production gaps',why:'AI becomes a gap resolver rather than the source of truth, reducing unnecessary generation and protecting approved brand assets.',analogs:[['Nestlé','Adobe documents Nestlé using Firefly Custom Models to create commercially safe, on-brand campaign imagery from approved brand inputs, reducing the need for new production and reshoots. The public case supports governed gap-filling generation, though not the exact required-minus-existing calculation shown here.','https://business.adobe.com/customer-success-stories/nestle.html']]},
        {n:4,category:'auto',role:'creative',owner:'With Creative Teams',title:'Assemble Variants',short:'Approved components composed into every required format — 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 — per brand and SKU, from reusable profiles.',purpose:'Automatically construct production-ready channel variants from approved components and governed templates.',items:['Place product, logo, imagery, copy and legal content into reusable templates.','Apply crop, safe-zone, typography and layout rules.','Recompose rather than simply resize for each channel format.','Generate consistent families of assets from one approved concept.'],input:'Components + templates',output:'Channel variants',flow:'Approved components + layout profile → 1:1 / 9:16 / 16:9 / retail / display outputs',why:'One approved concept can become hundreds of production-ready sizes without requiring a designer to manually rebuild every file.',analogs:[['Newell Brands','Adobe documents Newell Brands using Firefly Services, Custom Models, Adobe Express, Workfront, and AEM Assets to automate high-volume content production and create channel-specific variations across its portfolio of 50+ brands.','https://business.adobe.com/blog/newell-brands-reimagines-its-content-supply-chain-with-adobe']]},
        {n:5,category:'auto',role:'market',owner:'With Market Teams',title:'Localize per Market',short:'Transcreation, copy-length reflow, RTL mirroring, vertical setting, and market-correct legal footers — rules as data.',purpose:'Adapt master creative for each market without allowing every region to reinvent the campaign.',items:['Translate or transcreate copy using market-approved terminology.','Apply currency, units, pricing and market-specific product availability.','Adjust copy length, line breaking, RTL or vertical typography where required.','Insert local legal text, disclaimers and approved regional imagery.','Apply market-specific calls to action and cultural rules.'],input:'Master channel variants',output:'Market-specific variants',flow:'Master creative + market policy package → localized creative',why:'Localization becomes a governed production system rather than a manual handoff between global and regional teams.',analogs:[['Adobe','Adobe documents its own GenStudio workflow adapting master creative across 20+ countries, with LATAM localization time reduced by 75%. This is a direct example of centrally governed creative being adapted for local markets at scale.','https://business.adobe.com/customer-success-stories/customer-zero-adobe-genstudio-for-performance-marketing.html'],['Coca-Cola','Adobe describes Coca-Cola using a content-supply-chain architecture that produces on-brand localized variants while coordinating execution across markets.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2026/sessions/velocity-at-scale-how-coca-cola-deaveraged-its-con-s915.html']]},
        {n:6,category:'auto',role:'creative',owner:'With Brand Standards',title:'Scrub for Spec Compliance',short:'The brand book compiled into blocking rules: clear space, color tokens, type licensing, copy limits. Auto-pass or auto-fix.',purpose:'Automatically check objective brand, legal and channel requirements before a human reviewer sees the work.',items:['Validate logo usage, clear space, colors, typography and approved asset treatments.','Check channel dimensions, safe areas, file size and copy-length limits.','Validate required disclosures, product claims and asset rights.','Auto-correct safe deterministic issues where permitted.','Produce a structured pass/fail exception report.'],input:'Localized variants',output:'Compliance report',flow:'Creative variant → rules engine → pass / auto-fix / exception',why:'The system converts the brand book from a document people must remember into policy that production can automatically enforce.',analogs:[['Lenovo','Adobe documents Lenovo loading granular brand and channel guidelines into GenStudio and evaluating generated content against those rules, providing a direct analogue for automated brand-compliance checking.','https://business.adobe.com/blog/the-latest/lenovo-talks-adobe-genstudio-for-performance-marketing']]},
        {n:7,category:'human',role:'human',owner:'Human in the Loop',title:'Route Human Review',short:'Anything flagged queues to Brand Standards reviewers — automation with escape hatches, not automation instead of people.',purpose:'Move humans from repetitive inspection to exception handling, ambiguity and high-risk decisions.',items:['Route only flagged or policy-required items to the correct reviewer.','Require mandatory review for sensitive markets, legal claims or designated campaigns.','Capture comments, decisions, rejection reasons and approval history.','Return rejected work to the correct workflow stage instead of restarting production.','Escalate unresolved exceptions to specialized owners.'],input:'Exceptions + required reviews',output:'Approval record',flow:'Automated QA → exception queue → human decision → approved or returned',why:'Human expertise is concentrated where judgment matters instead of being consumed by reviewing hundreds of routine variants.',analogs:[['Coca-Cola','Adobe documents Coca-Cola using structured digital gating, proofing, approvals, feedback, and decision points inside its marketing workflow — a direct enterprise analogue for routing work to humans where review is required.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2025/sessions/cocacola-crafting-a-techaugmented-marketing-s807.html']]},
        {n:8,category:'auto',role:'leadership',owner:'With IT + Leadership',title:'Write Back & Report',short:'Approved variants return to the DAM’s taxonomy with full lineage. The audit log feeds adoption, cycle-time, and ROI reporting.',purpose:'Close the production loop by returning approved assets and their metadata to the enterprise system of record.',items:['Write approved assets and metadata back into the DAM.','Preserve campaign, market, SKU, parent/master and format relationships.','Record approval state, version, provenance and reviewer history.','Feed cycle-time, automation rate, exception rate and adoption data into reporting.','Connect downstream performance data where available.'],input:'Approved assets + decision records',output:'DAM assets + operational metrics',flow:'Approved production output → DAM + analytics → measurable content supply chain',why:'Automation becomes measurable infrastructure: assets remain governed, leadership can see adoption and ROI, and the next campaign starts with better reusable content.',analogs:[['Newell Brands','Adobe documents Newell Brands connecting Workfront and AEM Assets so production metadata and approved content move through a managed asset lifecycle rather than ending as disconnected files.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2025/sessions/paving-new-ways-to-seamless-content-creation-at-ne-s743.html'],['Coca-Cola','Adobe describes Coca-Cola connecting content-supply-chain workflow data to measurement and analytics, while its 2026 architecture links Workfront/Fusion orchestration, Frame.io review, Firefly generation, and AEM Assets.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2026/sessions/velocity-at-scale-how-coca-cola-deaveraged-its-con-s915.html']]}
      ];

      const cards=document.getElementById('cards');
      const drawer=document.getElementById('drawer');
      const layout=document.getElementById('layout');
      const closeBtn=document.getElementById('closeDrawer');
      let current=null;

      data.forEach(d=>{
        const b=document.createElement('button');
        b.type='button';
        b.className='step '+d.category;
        b.dataset.step=String(d.n);
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        b.innerHTML=`<span class="num">${d.n}</span><span class="owner ${d.role}">${d.owner}</span><h2>${d.title}</h2><p>${d.short}</p><span class="explore">Explore step →</span>`;
        b.addEventListener('click',()=>openStep(d.n));
        cards.appendChild(b);
      });

      function renderAnalogs(d){
        const wrap=document.getElementById('analogs');
        const detail=document.getElementById('analogDetail');
        wrap.innerHTML='';
        const renderDetail=a=>{
          detail.innerHTML='';
          const badge=document.createElement('div');
          badge.className='case-badge';
          badge.textContent='Documented case study';
          const copy=document.createElement('div');
          copy.textContent=a[1];
          const link=document.createElement('a');
          link.className='case-link';
          link.href=a[2];
          link.target='_blank';
          link.rel='noopener noreferrer';
          link.textContent='View case study ↗';
          detail.appendChild(badge);
          detail.appendChild(copy);
          detail.appendChild(link);
        };
        d.analogs.forEach((a,i)=>{
          const btn=document.createElement('button');
          btn.type='button';
          btn.className='analog'+(i===0?' selected':'');
          btn.textContent=a[0];
          btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
            wrap.querySelectorAll('.analog').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
            btn.classList.add('selected');
            renderDetail(a);
          });
          wrap.appendChild(btn);
        });
        renderDetail(d.analogs[0]);
      }

      function openStep(n){
        const d=data[n-1];
        current=n;
        document.getElementById('drawerNum').textContent=d.n;
        document.getElementById('drawerTitle').textContent=d.title;
        const drawerOwner=document.getElementById('drawerOwner');
        drawerOwner.textContent=d.owner;
        drawerOwner.className='drawer-owner '+d.role;
        document.getElementById('purpose').textContent=d.purpose;
        document.getElementById('input').textContent=d.input;
        document.getElementById('output').textContent=d.output;
        document.getElementById('flow').textContent=d.flow;
        document.getElementById('why').textContent=d.why;
        const ul=document.getElementById('happens');
        ul.innerHTML='';
        d.items.forEach(item=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=item;ul.appendChild(li)});
        renderAnalogs(d);

        drawer.classList.remove('auto','human');
        drawer.classList.add('open',d.category);
        cards.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach(el=>{
          const sn=Number(el.dataset.step);
          el.classList.remove('active');
          el.setAttribute('aria-expanded',sn===n?'true':'false');
          if(sn===n) el.classList.add('active');
        });
        drawer.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
      }

      function closeDrawer(){
        current=null;
        drawer.classList.remove('open','auto','human');
        cards.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach(el=>{el.classList.remove('active');el.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')});
      }
      closeBtn.addEventListener('click',closeDrawer);
      root.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&current!==null)closeDrawer()});
    })();
  </script>
</div>
  <p style="margin-top:26px;"><a class="btn" href="https://brand-scalability-system.netlify.app/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Try the Live Prototype &rarr;</a></p>
</section>

<!-- ROI -->
<section id="roi">
  <p class="eyebrow">Value &amp; ROI Proposal</p>
  <h2>How We Prove ROI with the Automated Ad System</h2>
  <p class="serif" style="font-style:italic; font-size:15px; max-width:900px; margin-top:16px;">The pilot’s 60% brief-to-post reduction proves the tooling works &mdash; but how do we prove ROI? The business case for scaling the Automated Ad System must show that it gets campaigns to market sooner, reduces risk, lowers the cost of scale, and can be operated by the organization without proportional engineering support.</p>
  <p style="font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gray); margin-top:14px;">&#9632;&nbsp; Proven in pilot: 60% brief-to-post reduction &middot; productivity proves the tooling works &mdash; these four business outcomes prove the ROI</p>
  <div class="pillars">
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">1</div>
      <h4>Revenue Velocity</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Are we getting campaigns to market faster and capturing value sooner?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Campaign cycle time: brief to live</li>
        <li>Time to enter a new market or launch a brand</li>
        <li>In-market days gained per campaign</li>
        <li>Revenue attributed to earlier launches</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Revenue sooner</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">2</div>
      <h4>Brand Integrity &amp; Risk</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Are we maintaining brand and compliance standards as production scales?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>First-pass compliance rate by market</li>
        <li>Brand or legal violations shipped to market (target: zero)</li>
        <li>Percent of assets with complete provenance / approval lineage</li>
        <li>Audit readiness: time required to trace an asset or variant</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Risk avoided</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">3</div>
      <h4>Economics of Scale</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Does the cost per approved asset decrease as brands and markets increase?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Cost per localized, approved variant</li>
        <li>Marginal cost of adding a brand or market</li>
        <li>Variant capacity per creative team</li>
        <li>Content reuse rate from the DAM</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Lower unit cost</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">4</div>
      <h4>Adoption &amp; Operational Capability</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Can teams operate and expand the platform without proportional engineering support?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Active brands and markets using the platform</li>
        <li>First-pass approval rate by reviewers</li>
        <li>Percent of teams self-serving after handoff</li>
        <li>Trained champions per market</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Lower support dependency</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="eq">
    <p class="ey">Transformation ROI &middot; Reported Quarterly, Per Wave &middot; Compounding as Each Wave Onboards</p>
    <div class="eq-formula">
      <p class="eq-main">Business Value = Revenue Velocity + Risk Avoided + Scale Economics</p>
      <p class="eq-sub">ROI = ( Business Value &minus; Total Investment ) &divide; Total Investment</p>
      <p class="eq-note">Where Total Investment = Platform + Change-Management Investment</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="criteria-card">
    <div class="criteria-header">
      <h3>Wave 1 Must Meet the Scale Criteria</h3>
      <p>Wave 2 begins only when Wave 1 demonstrates quality, safety, efficiency, and operational independence in live campaign conditions.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-progression" aria-label="Scale Progression Framework">
      <div class="prog-item"><span class="prog-label">WAVE 1</span></div>
      <span class="prog-sep">&rarr;</span>
      <div class="prog-item"><span class="prog-label">MEASURE</span></div>
      <span class="prog-sep">&rarr;</span>
      <div class="prog-item"><span class="prog-label">MEET 4 SCALE CRITERIA</span></div>
      <span class="prog-sep">&rarr;</span>
      <div class="prog-item unlock-node"><span class="prog-label">UNLOCK WAVE 2</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="scorecard-grid">
      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Creative Quality</span>
        <span class="scorecard-target-label">TARGET</span>
        <div class="scorecard-target-value">At Least 90%</div>
        <div class="scorecard-measure">of localized variants approved on first review</div>
        <div class="scorecard-detail">without manual production correction</div>
        <div class="scorecard-proves">
          <strong>What This Proves</strong>
          The automated workflow consistently meets creative expectations before scale.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Brand Safety</span>
        <span class="scorecard-target-label">TARGET</span>
        <div class="scorecard-target-value">Zero</div>
        <div class="scorecard-measure">brand or legal violations</div>
        <div class="scorecard-detail">shipped to market</div>
        <div class="scorecard-proves">
          <strong>What This Proves</strong>
          Scaling the workflow does not compromise governance, brand standards, or compliance.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Operational Efficiency</span>
        <span class="scorecard-target-label">TARGET</span>
        <div class="scorecard-target-value">At Least 50%</div>
        <div class="scorecard-measure">cycle-time reduction</div>
        <div class="scorecard-detail">versus the manual baseline, sustained</div>
        <div class="scorecard-proves">
          <strong>What This Proves</strong>
          The transformation continues to deliver measurable operational value at scale.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Operational Independence</span>
        <span class="scorecard-target-label">TARGET</span>
        <div class="scorecard-target-value">At Least 2 of 3</div>
        <div class="scorecard-measure">Wave 1 brands operating without engineering support</div>
        <div class="scorecard-detail">sustained operational independence</div>
        <div class="scorecard-proves">
          <strong>What This Proves</strong>
          The platform can expand without requiring proportional engineering support for every brand.
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-decision">
      <p class="decision-main">Meet all four criteria &rarr; <span class="unlock-highlight">UNLOCK WAVE 2</span> (unlock the next wave).</p>
      <p class="decision-detail">Miss a threshold &rarr; remediate before expansion. Scale is earned by evidence, not assumed.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- COMMITMENTS -->
<section id="commitments">
  <p class="eyebrow">North America Green</p>
  <h2>Each Concern Becomes a Design Commitment</h2>
  <p class="sub">Centralize the infrastructure. Federate creative control.</p>
  <div class="rows">
    <div class="row cmo"><b>Global CMO</b><p>Tie every run to margin, market coverage, growth, quality, and risk &mdash; not just speed.</p></div>
    <div class="row ops"><b>Content Ops</b><p>Standardize metadata, rules, approvals, and interfaces before scaling creative volume.</p></div>
    <div class="row creative"><b>Creative + Brand</b><p>Lock logos, products, and core design intent; automate only approved adaptive zones.</p></div>
    <div class="row market"><b>Japan Market</b><p>Make local teams owners of locale packs, cultural rules, transcreation, and final approval.</p></div>
    <div class="row it"><b>IT / Engineering</b><p>Use thin adapters, configuration over custom code, observable jobs, tests, and full handoff.</p></div>

<!-- GOAL + SCALE -->
<section id="goal">
  <p class="eyebrow">The Goal &amp; the Scale of the Challenge</p>
  <h2>The Pilot Proved the Value. Now We Must Scale It.</h2>
  <div class="twocol">
    <div>
      <div class="panel g">
        <h3>The Goal</h3>
        <p class="serif" style="font-size:14px; margin-bottom:10px;"><b style="font-style:italic; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">Eliminate repetitive manual adaptation</b> through a governed, metadata-driven system that:</p>
        <ul>
          <li>Uses generative AI within approved brand rules</li>
          <li>Connects to the company's existing DAM and PIM</li>
          <li>Automates localization and specification compliance</li>
          <li>Preserves human review and creative oversight</li>
          <li>Delivers approved assets back to the DAM</li>
        </ul>
      </div>
      <div class="stat"><b class="gr">60%</b><i>reduction in brief-to-post time</i></div>

        <p style="margin-top:10px;">Each brand-market pair carries four variation types per campaign. The live prototype models a single-variation run &mdash; 50 &times; 20 &times; 3 formats = 3,000 variants &mdash; and four variations per brand-market is what takes the operation to 12,000 final deliverables. Same pipeline, run four times per campaign message.</p>

    /* METRICS */

    .scale-result-top{display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; margin-bottom:28px;}
    .scale-result-label{margin:0; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink);}
    .scale-model-note{margin:6px 0 0; font-family:Georgia,serif; font-style:italic; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--gray);}
    .scale-retained-number{text-align:right;}
    .scale-retained-number strong{display:block; font-size:clamp(48px,6.5vw,76px); line-height:0.9; font-weight:700; font-style:italic; letter-spacing:-0.04em; color:var(--green);}
    .scale-retained-number span{display:block; margin-top:8px; font-size:9.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gray);}

    /* BARS */
    .scale-bar-group + .scale-bar-group{margin-top:18px;}
    .scale-bar-label{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:6px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; font-style:italic;}
    .scale-bar-track{width:100%; height:14px; overflow:hidden; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.08);}
    .scale-bar{height:100%; transition:width 280ms ease;}
    .scale-bar-pilot{background:var(--ink);}
    .scale-bar-current{background:var(--green);}

    /* DYNAMIC EXPLANATION */
    .scale-message{margin-top:24px; padding:12px 16px; max-width:820px; border-left:3.5px solid var(--green); background:var(--tint2); font-family:Georgia,serif; font-style:italic; font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.5; color:var(--ink);}

    /* COMPARISON */
    .scale-comparison{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr; align-items:stretch; gap:18px; margin-top:24px;}
    .scale-comparison-item{display:flex; gap:16px; padding:22px; border:1px solid var(--hairline); background:var(--white);}
    .scale-comparison-highlight{background:var(--green); color:var(--white); border-color:var(--green);}
    .scale-comparison-number{font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.14em; opacity:0.7;}
    .scale-comparison-item h3{margin:0 0 6px; font-size:17px; font-weight:700; font-style:italic;}
    .scale-comparison-item p{margin:0; font-family:Georgia,serif; font-size:13.5px; line-height:1.45; opacity:0.85;}
    .scale-comparison-highlight p{opacity:0.92;}
    .scale-comparison-arrow{align-self:center; font-size:24px; font-weight:700; color:var(--green-mid);}

    /* RESPONSIVE */
    @media (max-width:840px){
      .scale-controls{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:18px; padding:18px 20px;}

      .scale-result{padding:22px 20px;}
      .scale-result-top{flex-direction:column; gap:14px;}

    }
  </style>

  <div class="scale-stress-header">
    <p class="scale-eyebrow">SCALE STRESS TEST</p>
    <h2>
      Can We Preserve the
      <span>60% Gain at Global Scale?</span>
    </h2>
    <p class="scale-intro">
      The pilot proved the workflow can reduce brief-to-post time by 60%.
      Now test what happens as the number of brands and markets increases.
    </p>
  </div>

  <!-- CONTROLS -->
  <div class="scale-controls">
    <div class="scale-control">
      <div class="scale-control-label">
        <label for="scale-brands">Brands</label>
        <strong id="scale-brand-value">50</strong>
      </div>
      <input type="range" id="scale-brands" min="1" max="50" value="50" step="1" aria-label="Number of brands">
      <div class="scale-range-labels">
        <span>1</span>
        <span>50</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-control">
      <div class="scale-control-label">
        <label for="scale-markets">Markets</label>
        <strong id="scale-market-value">20</strong>
      </div>
      <input type="range" id="scale-markets" min="1" max="20" value="20" step="1" aria-label="Number of markets">
      <div class="scale-range-labels">
        <span>1</span>
        <span>20</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-control">
      <div class="scale-control-label">
        <label for="scale-automation">Adaptation Automated</label>
        <strong id="scale-automation-value">80%</strong>
      </div>
      <input type="range" id="scale-automation" min="0" max="100" value="80" step="5" aria-label="Adaptation automated percentage">
      <div class="scale-range-labels">
        <span>Manual</span>
        <span>Automated</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- OUTPUT NUMBERS -->
  <div class="scale-metrics">
    <div class="scale-metric">
      <span class="scale-metric-label">BRAND &times; MARKET PAIRS</span>
      <strong id="scale-pairs">1,000</strong>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-metric">
      <span class="scale-metric-label">FINAL DELIVERABLES</span>
      <strong id="scale-deliverables">12,000</strong>
      <small>4 creative variations &times; 3 formats</small>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-metric">
      <span class="scale-metric-label">MANUAL ADAPTATIONS</span>
      <strong id="scale-manual">2,400</strong>
      <small>Production work still requiring human handling</small>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- 60% VISUALIZATION -->
  <div class="scale-result">
    <div class="scale-result-top">
      <div>
        <p class="scale-result-label">HOW MUCH OF THE PILOT GAIN SURVIVES?</p>
        <p class="scale-model-note">Illustrative scenario model &mdash; not a measured forecast</p>
      </div>
      <div class="scale-retained-number">
        <strong id="scale-retained">51%</strong>
        <span>PROJECTED IMPROVEMENT</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- PILOT -->
    <div class="scale-bar-group">
      <div class="scale-bar-label">
        <span>Pilot Benchmark</span>
        <strong>60%</strong>
      </div>
      <div class="scale-bar-track">
        <div class="scale-bar scale-bar-pilot" style="width: 60%;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- SCALED -->
    <div class="scale-bar-group">
      <div class="scale-bar-label">
        <span>At Current Scale</span>
        <strong id="scale-retained-small">51%</strong>
      </div>
      <div class="scale-bar-track">
        <div class="scale-bar scale-bar-current" id="scale-retained-bar" style="width: 51%;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- EXPLANATION -->
    <div class="scale-message" id="scale-message">
      At 50 brands &times; 20 markets, automating 80% of repetitive adaptation preserves most of the pilot gain while keeping humans focused on review and exceptions.
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- MANUAL VS AUTOMATED -->
  <div class="scale-comparison">
    <div class="scale-comparison-item">
      <span class="scale-comparison-number">01</span>
      <div>
        <h3>Manual Scaling</h3>
        <p>More brands and markets create more localization, resizing, copy adaptation, and specification work. Human production becomes the bottleneck.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-comparison-arrow">&rarr;</div>

    <div class="scale-comparison-item scale-comparison-highlight">
      <span class="scale-comparison-number">02</span>
      <div>
        <h3>Automated Scaling</h3>
        <p>The platform performs repetitive production work. Humans stay in the loop for creative judgment, exceptions, brand quality, and final approval.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const root = document.getElementById("scale-stress-test");
      if (!root) return;

      const CONFIG = {
        pilotGain: 60,
        maxBrands: 50,
        maxMarkets: 20,
        variationsPerPair: 4,
        formatsPerVariation: 3,
        maximumErosion: 45
      };

      const brandsInput = root.querySelector("#scale-brands");
      const marketsInput = root.querySelector("#scale-markets");
      const automationInput = root.querySelector("#scale-automation");

      const brandValue = root.querySelector("#scale-brand-value");
      const marketValue = root.querySelector("#scale-market-value");
      const automationValue = root.querySelector("#scale-automation-value");

      const pairsElement = root.querySelector("#scale-pairs");
      const deliverablesElement = root.querySelector("#scale-deliverables");
      const manualElement = root.querySelector("#scale-manual");

      const retainedElement = root.querySelector("#scale-retained");
      const retainedSmallElement = root.querySelector("#scale-retained-small");
      const retainedBar = root.querySelector("#scale-retained-bar");
      const messageElement = root.querySelector("#scale-message");

      const formatter = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US");

      function calculateModel() {
        const brands = Number(brandsInput.value);
        const markets = Number(marketsInput.value);
        const automation = Number(automationInput.value);

        const pairs = brands * markets;
        const deliverables = pairs * CONFIG.variationsPerPair * CONFIG.formatsPerVariation;
        const manualShare = 1 - (automation / 100);
        const manualAdaptations = Math.round(deliverables * manualShare);

        const maximumPairs = CONFIG.maxBrands * CONFIG.maxMarkets;
        const scalePressure = Math.log10(Math.max(1, pairs)) / Math.log10(maximumPairs);

        const erosion = CONFIG.maximumErosion * scalePressure * manualShare;
        const retainedGain = Math.max(
          CONFIG.pilotGain - CONFIG.maximumErosion,
          Math.min(CONFIG.pilotGain, CONFIG.pilotGain - erosion)
        );

        return {
          brands,
          markets,
          automation,
          pairs,
          deliverables,
          manualAdaptations,
          retainedGain
        };
      }

      function updateInterface() {
        const data = calculateModel();
        const retained = Math.round(data.retainedGain);

        brandValue.textContent = data.brands;
        marketValue.textContent = data.markets;
        automationValue.textContent = data.automation + "%";

        pairsElement.textContent = formatter.format(data.pairs);
        deliverablesElement.textContent = formatter.format(data.deliverables);
        manualElement.textContent = formatter.format(data.manualAdaptations);

        retainedElement.textContent = retained + "%";
        retainedSmallElement.textContent = retained + "%";
        retainedBar.style.width = retained + "%";

        if (data.pairs <= 4) {
          messageElement.textContent =
            "At pilot-like scale, the original 60% improvement is largely protected because the manual workload remains small.";
        } else if (data.automation >= 75) {
          messageElement.textContent =
            `At ${data.brands} brands × ${data.markets} markets, automating ${data.automation}% of repetitive adaptation preserves most of the pilot gain while keeping humans focused on creative review and exceptions.`;
        } else if (data.automation >= 40) {
          messageElement.textContent =
            `At ${data.brands} brands × ${data.markets} markets, the growing manual workload begins to consume the pilot advantage. More automation is required to preserve the original 60% improvement.`;
        } else {
          messageElement.textContent =
            `At ${data.brands} brands × ${data.markets} markets, scaling primarily through human production creates a major bottleneck. The pilot worked, but its efficiency advantage cannot scale with the workload.`;
        }
      }

      brandsInput.addEventListener("input", updateInterface);
      marketsInput.addEventListener("input", updateInterface);
      automationInput.addEventListener("input", updateInterface);

      updateInterface();
    })();
  </script>
</section>

<!-- PLAN -->
<section id="plan">
  <p class="eyebrow">Transformation Roadmap</p>
  <h2>Six-Month Transformation Plan</h2>
  <p class="sub">From Successful Pilot to Scalable Global Operations</p>
  <div class="plan">
    <div class="phase">
      <p class="mo">Month 1</p><h4>1. Discover and Standardize</h4>
      <ul><li>Audit existing brand assets and workflows</li><li>Define the metadata schema and naming conventions</li><li>Inventory style guides, design systems, SKUs, templates, and sample ads</li><li>Establish measurable pilot and business-success criteria</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase alt">
      <p class="mo">Month 2</p><h4>2. Build the Data Foundation</h4>
      <ul><li>Organize approved assets within the DAM</li><li>Connect product and SKU data from the PIM</li><li>Create reusable JSON brand-and-market profiles</li><li>Define permissions, governance rules, and approval requirements</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase">
      <p class="mo">Month 3</p><h4>3. Develop the MVP</h4>
      <ul><li>Build the DAM-to-ad-generation pipeline</li><li>Develop a role-based user interface</li><li>Generate new assets using approved brand components</li><li>Add automated localization and specification checks</li><li>Route outputs into human review</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase alt">
      <p class="mo">Month 4</p><h4>4. Test and Validate</h4>
      <ul><li>Bring creative, market, IT, and operations stakeholders together</li><li>Conduct integration, brand-quality, and localization testing</li><li>Run first-round QA and error analysis</li><li>Refine workflows based on stakeholder feedback</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase wave">
      <span class="flag">Wave 1</span>
      <p class="mo">Month 5</p><h4>5. Launch a Controlled Wave</h4>
      <ul><li>Roll out to three representative brands in two markets</li><li>Test in real campaign conditions</li><li>Train local teams and establish support resources</li><li>Track adoption, quality, cycle time, and first-pass approval</li></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="phase alt">
      <p class="mo">Month 6</p><h4>6. Handoff and Scale</h4>
      <ul><li>Transfer system ownership to internal stakeholders</li><li>Assign operational, governance, and technical roles</li><li>Deliver documentation, training, and support procedures</li><li>Establish ROI reporting and continuous improvement</li><li>Prepare the next group of brands and markets for rollout</li></ul>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="tracks">
    <div class="track"><b>Automation discovery embedded at every stage</b><div class="span"></div></div>
    <div class="track"><b>Stakeholder alignment, change management &amp; training</b><div class="span"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="note-added">
    <b>Wave 1 selection criteria &mdash; why these three brands, these two markets</b>
    <ul>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">One flagship, high-volume brand</b> &mdash; proves the system at real campaign pressure, where the ROI is largest.</li>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">One mid-tail brand</b> &mdash; represents the long tail where 40+ of the 50 brands actually live; validates self-serve economics.</li>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">One deliberately hard case</b> &mdash; a brand with strict guidelines or legacy asset debt, so Wave 1 earns credibility rather than an easy win.</li>
      <li><b style="color:var(--ink); display:inline; font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;">Markets: one Western anchor + Japan</b> &mdash; Japan stress-tests the localization engine (idiom transcreation, vertical setting, distinct legal footers) and puts the local team in the pilot as owners, not recipients.</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

  <script>
    (()=>{

      const data=[
        {n:1,category:'auto',role:'ops',owner:'With Content Ops',title:'Ingest the Campaign Brief',short:'One JSON brief defines brand, markets, formats, audiences, and message — the contract for everything downstream.',purpose:'Convert a human marketing request into a structured, machine-readable production contract.',items:['Validate brand, market, audience, product, channel and due-date fields.','Normalize naming and taxonomy so downstream systems receive consistent values.','Assign a campaign/job ID and resolve the rules that apply to each market and format.','Calculate the required outputs before production begins.'],input:'Campaign brief / JSON',output:'Campaign manifest',flow:'Campaign requirements → structured job definition → downstream production rules',why:'The brief becomes executable data rather than a set of instructions that every production team has to reinterpret.',analogs:[['Coca-Cola','Adobe documents Coca-Cola using Workfront intake forms and standardized workflows to capture project information, automatically create projects, and coordinate global, operating-unit, and market execution.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2025/sessions/cocacola-crafting-a-techaugmented-marketing-s807.html']]},
        {n:2,category:'auto',role:'it',owner:'With IT / Engineering',title:'Sync the Legacy DAM',short:'Read-only pull of approved assets, tagged by role and SHA-256 fingerprint. The DAM stays the system of record.',purpose:'Connect the automation layer to existing approved content without replacing the organization’s DAM.',items:['Query the DAM through APIs using campaign and product metadata.','Retrieve approved asset IDs, versions, rights and usage status.','Map legacy taxonomy into the automation workflow.','Use asset identity and version information to detect changes and avoid duplicates.'],input:'Campaign manifest',output:'Approved asset manifest',flow:'Campaign manifest → DAM API + metadata matching → approved source assets',why:'Existing approved assets are reused first, while the DAM remains authoritative and no new content silo is created.',analogs:[['Genpact','Adobe documents Genpact connecting Workfront-driven content workflows with AEM Assets so teams can work from governed, approved enterprise assets rather than recreate content in separate silos.','https://business.adobe.com/customer-success-stories/genpact.html']]},
        {n:3,category:'auto',role:'creative',owner:'With Brand Standards',title:'Resolve Missing Assets',short:'Gaps are generated with approved services from approved components — provenance flag and human-review marker on.',purpose:'Perform an asset coverage check and create or request only what the campaign is missing.',items:['Compare required campaign components with the approved asset manifest.','Reuse existing assets wherever possible.','Generate eligible missing backgrounds, crops or treatments from approved components.','Flag generated material with provenance and review metadata.','Route non-generatable gaps to the appropriate production owner.'],input:'Approved asset manifest',output:'Complete component set',flow:'Required components − available components = production gaps',why:'AI becomes a gap resolver rather than the source of truth, reducing unnecessary generation and protecting approved brand assets.',analogs:[['Nestlé','Adobe documents Nestlé using Firefly Custom Models to create commercially safe, on-brand campaign imagery from approved brand inputs, reducing the need for new production and reshoots. The public case supports governed gap-filling generation, though not the exact required-minus-existing calculation shown here.','https://business.adobe.com/customer-success-stories/nestle.html']]},
        {n:4,category:'auto',role:'creative',owner:'With Creative Teams',title:'Assemble Variants',short:'Approved components composed into every required format — 1:1, 9:16, 16:9 — per brand and SKU, from reusable profiles.',purpose:'Automatically construct production-ready channel variants from approved components and governed templates.',items:['Place product, logo, imagery, copy and legal content into reusable templates.','Apply crop, safe-zone, typography and layout rules.','Recompose rather than simply resize for each channel format.','Generate consistent families of assets from one approved concept.'],input:'Components + templates',output:'Channel variants',flow:'Approved components + layout profile → 1:1 / 9:16 / 16:9 / retail / display outputs',why:'One approved concept can become hundreds of production-ready sizes without requiring a designer to manually rebuild every file.',analogs:[['Newell Brands','Adobe documents Newell Brands using Firefly Services, Custom Models, Adobe Express, Workfront, and AEM Assets to automate high-volume content production and create channel-specific variations across its portfolio of 50+ brands.','https://business.adobe.com/blog/newell-brands-reimagines-its-content-supply-chain-with-adobe']]},
        {n:5,category:'auto',role:'market',owner:'With Market Teams',title:'Localize per Market',short:'Transcreation, copy-length reflow, RTL mirroring, vertical setting, and market-correct legal footers — rules as data.',purpose:'Adapt master creative for each market without allowing every region to reinvent the campaign.',items:['Translate or transcreate copy using market-approved terminology.','Apply currency, units, pricing and market-specific product availability.','Adjust copy length, line breaking, RTL or vertical typography where required.','Insert local legal text, disclaimers and approved regional imagery.','Apply market-specific calls to action and cultural rules.'],input:'Master channel variants',output:'Market-specific variants',flow:'Master creative + market policy package → localized creative',why:'Localization becomes a governed production system rather than a manual handoff between global and regional teams.',analogs:[['Adobe','Adobe documents its own GenStudio workflow adapting master creative across 20+ countries, with LATAM localization time reduced by 75%. This is a direct example of centrally governed creative being adapted for local markets at scale.','https://business.adobe.com/customer-success-stories/customer-zero-adobe-genstudio-for-performance-marketing.html'],['Coca-Cola','Adobe describes Coca-Cola using a content-supply-chain architecture that produces on-brand localized variants while coordinating execution across markets.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2026/sessions/velocity-at-scale-how-coca-cola-deaveraged-its-con-s915.html']]},
        {n:6,category:'auto',role:'creative',owner:'With Brand Standards',title:'Scrub for Spec Compliance',short:'The brand book compiled into blocking rules: clear space, color tokens, type licensing, copy limits. Auto-pass or auto-fix.',purpose:'Automatically check objective brand, legal and channel requirements before a human reviewer sees the work.',items:['Validate logo usage, clear space, colors, typography and approved asset treatments.','Check channel dimensions, safe areas, file size and copy-length limits.','Validate required disclosures, product claims and asset rights.','Auto-correct safe deterministic issues where permitted.','Produce a structured pass/fail exception report.'],input:'Localized variants',output:'Compliance report',flow:'Creative variant → rules engine → pass / auto-fix / exception',why:'The system converts the brand book from a document people must remember into policy that production can automatically enforce.',analogs:[['Lenovo','Adobe documents Lenovo loading granular brand and channel guidelines into GenStudio and evaluating generated content against those rules, providing a direct analogue for automated brand-compliance checking.','https://business.adobe.com/blog/the-latest/lenovo-talks-adobe-genstudio-for-performance-marketing']]},
        {n:7,category:'human',role:'human',owner:'Human in the Loop',title:'Route Human Review',short:'Anything flagged queues to Brand Standards reviewers — automation with escape hatches, not automation instead of people.',purpose:'Move humans from repetitive inspection to exception handling, ambiguity and high-risk decisions.',items:['Route only flagged or policy-required items to the correct reviewer.','Require mandatory review for sensitive markets, legal claims or designated campaigns.','Capture comments, decisions, rejection reasons and approval history.','Return rejected work to the correct workflow stage instead of restarting production.','Escalate unresolved exceptions to specialized owners.'],input:'Exceptions + required reviews',output:'Approval record',flow:'Automated QA → exception queue → human decision → approved or returned',why:'Human expertise is concentrated where judgment matters instead of being consumed by reviewing hundreds of routine variants.',analogs:[['Coca-Cola','Adobe documents Coca-Cola using structured digital gating, proofing, approvals, feedback, and decision points inside its marketing workflow — a direct enterprise analogue for routing work to humans where review is required.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2025/sessions/cocacola-crafting-a-techaugmented-marketing-s807.html']]},
        {n:8,category:'auto',role:'leadership',owner:'With IT + Leadership',title:'Write Back & Report',short:'Approved variants return to the DAM’s taxonomy with full lineage. The audit log feeds adoption, cycle-time, and ROI reporting.',purpose:'Close the production loop by returning approved assets and their metadata to the enterprise system of record.',items:['Write approved assets and metadata back into the DAM.','Preserve campaign, market, SKU, parent/master and format relationships.','Record approval state, version, provenance and reviewer history.','Feed cycle-time, automation rate, exception rate and adoption data into reporting.','Connect downstream performance data where available.'],input:'Approved assets + decision records',output:'DAM assets + operational metrics',flow:'Approved production output → DAM + analytics → measurable content supply chain',why:'Automation becomes measurable infrastructure: assets remain governed, leadership can see adoption and ROI, and the next campaign starts with better reusable content.',analogs:[['Newell Brands','Adobe documents Newell Brands connecting Workfront and AEM Assets so production metadata and approved content move through a managed asset lifecycle rather than ending as disconnected files.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2025/sessions/paving-new-ways-to-seamless-content-creation-at-ne-s743.html'],['Coca-Cola','Adobe describes Coca-Cola connecting content-supply-chain workflow data to measurement and analytics, while its 2026 architecture links Workfront/Fusion orchestration, Frame.io review, Firefly generation, and AEM Assets.','https://business.adobe.com/summit/2026/sessions/velocity-at-scale-how-coca-cola-deaveraged-its-con-s915.html']]}
      ];

      const cards=document.getElementById('cards');
      const drawer=document.getElementById('drawer');
      const layout=document.getElementById('layout');
      const closeBtn=document.getElementById('closeDrawer');
      let current=null;

      data.forEach(d=>{
        const b=document.createElement('button');
        b.type='button';
        b.className='step '+d.category;
        b.dataset.step=String(d.n);
        b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
        b.innerHTML=`<span class="num">${d.n}</span><span class="owner ${d.role}">${d.owner}</span><h2>${d.title}</h2><p>${d.short}</p><span class="explore">Explore step →</span>`;
        b.addEventListener('click',()=>openStep(d.n));
        cards.appendChild(b);
      });

      function renderAnalogs(d){
        const wrap=document.getElementById('analogs');
        const detail=document.getElementById('analogDetail');
        wrap.innerHTML='';
        const renderDetail=a=>{
          detail.innerHTML='';
          const badge=document.createElement('div');
          badge.className='case-badge';
          badge.textContent='Documented case study';
          const copy=document.createElement('div');
          copy.textContent=a[1];
          const link=document.createElement('a');
          link.className='case-link';
          link.href=a[2];
          link.target='_blank';
          link.rel='noopener noreferrer';
          link.textContent='View case study ↗';
          detail.appendChild(badge);
          detail.appendChild(copy);
          detail.appendChild(link);
        };
        d.analogs.forEach((a,i)=>{
          const btn=document.createElement('button');
          btn.type='button';
          btn.className='analog'+(i===0?' selected':'');
          btn.textContent=a[0];
          btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
            wrap.querySelectorAll('.analog').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('selected'));
            btn.classList.add('selected');
            renderDetail(a);
          });
          wrap.appendChild(btn);
        });
        renderDetail(d.analogs[0]);
      }

      function openStep(n){
        const d=data[n-1];
        current=n;
        document.getElementById('drawerNum').textContent=d.n;
        document.getElementById('drawerTitle').textContent=d.title;
        const drawerOwner=document.getElementById('drawerOwner');
        drawerOwner.textContent=d.owner;
        drawerOwner.className='drawer-owner '+d.role;
        document.getElementById('purpose').textContent=d.purpose;
        document.getElementById('input').textContent=d.input;
        document.getElementById('output').textContent=d.output;
        document.getElementById('flow').textContent=d.flow;
        document.getElementById('why').textContent=d.why;
        const ul=document.getElementById('happens');
        ul.innerHTML='';
        d.items.forEach(item=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=item;ul.appendChild(li)});
        renderAnalogs(d);

        drawer.classList.remove('auto','human');
        drawer.classList.add('open',d.category);
        cards.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach(el=>{
          const sn=Number(el.dataset.step);
          el.classList.remove('active');
          el.setAttribute('aria-expanded',sn===n?'true':'false');
          if(sn===n) el.classList.add('active');
        });
        drawer.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'nearest'});
      }

      function closeDrawer(){
        current=null;
        drawer.classList.remove('open','auto','human');
        cards.querySelectorAll('.step').forEach(el=>{el.classList.remove('active');el.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')});
      }
      closeBtn.addEventListener('click',closeDrawer);
      root.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'&&current!==null)closeDrawer()});
    })();
  </script>
</div>
