<!-- ROI -->
<section id="roi">
  <p class="eyebrow">Value &amp; ROI Proposal</p>
  <h2>How We Prove ROI with the Automated Ad System</h2>
  <p class="serif" style="font-style:italic; font-size:15px; max-width:900px; margin-top:16px;">The pilot’s 60% brief-to-post reduction proves the tooling works &mdash; but how do we prove ROI? The business case for scaling the Automated Ad System must show that it gets campaigns to market sooner, reduces risk, lowers the cost of scale, and can be operated by the organization without proportional engineering support.</p>
  <p style="font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gray); margin-top:14px;">&#9632;&nbsp; Proven in pilot: 60% brief-to-post reduction &middot; productivity proves the tooling works &mdash; these four business outcomes prove the ROI</p>
  <div class="pillars">
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">1</div>
      <h4>Revenue Velocity</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Are we getting campaigns to market faster and capturing value sooner?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Campaign cycle time: brief to live</li>
        <li>Time to enter a new market or launch a brand</li>
        <li>In-market days gained per campaign</li>
        <li>Revenue attributed to earlier launches</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Revenue sooner</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">2</div>
      <h4>Brand Integrity &amp; Risk</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Are we maintaining brand and compliance standards as production scales?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>First-pass compliance rate by market</li>
        <li>Brand or legal violations shipped to market (target: zero)</li>
        <li>Percent of assets with complete provenance / approval lineage</li>
        <li>Audit readiness: time required to trace an asset or variant</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Risk avoided</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">3</div>
      <h4>Economics of Scale</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Does the cost per approved asset decrease as brands and markets increase?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Cost per localized, approved variant</li>
        <li>Marginal cost of adding a brand or market</li>
        <li>Variant capacity per creative team</li>
        <li>Content reuse rate from the DAM</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Lower unit cost</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="pillar">
      <div class="num">4</div>
      <h4>Adoption &amp; Operational Capability</h4>
      <p class="ask">The board asks: &ldquo;Can teams operate and expand the platform without proportional engineering support?&rdquo;</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Active brands and markets using the platform</li>
        <li>First-pass approval rate by reviewers</li>
        <li>Percent of teams self-serving after handoff</li>
        <li>Trained champions per market</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="pillar-val">Value: <span>Lower support dependency</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="eq">
    <p class="ey">Transformation ROI &middot; Reported Quarterly, Per Wave &middot; Compounding as Each Wave Onboards</p>
    <div class="eq-formula">
      <p class="eq-main">Business Value = Revenue Velocity + Risk Avoided + Scale Economics</p>
      <p class="eq-sub">ROI = ( Business Value &minus; Total Investment ) &divide; Total Investment</p>
      <p class="eq-note">Where Total Investment = Platform + Change-Management Investment</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="criteria-card">
    <div class="criteria-header">
      <h3>Wave 1 Must Meet the Scale Criteria</h3>
      <p>Wave 2 begins only when Wave 1 demonstrates quality, safety, efficiency, and operational independence in live campaign conditions.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="scale-progression" aria-label="Scale Progression Framework">
      <div class="prog-item"><span class="prog-label">WAVE 1</span></div>
      <span class="prog-sep">&rarr;</span>
      <div class="prog-item"><span class="prog-label">MEASURE</span></div>
      <span class="prog-sep">&rarr;</span>
      <div class="prog-item"><span class="prog-label">MEET 4 SCALE CRITERIA</span></div>
      <span class="prog-sep">&rarr;</span>
      <div class="prog-item unlock-node"><span class="prog-label">UNLOCK WAVE 2</span></div>
    </div>

    <div class="scorecard-grid">
      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Creative Quality</span>
        <span class="scorecard-target-label">TARGET</span>
        <div class="scorecard-target-value">At Least 90%</div>
        <div class="scorecard-measure">of localized variants approved on first review</div>
        <div class="scorecard-detail">without manual production correction</div>
        <div class="scorecard-proves">
          <strong>What This Proves</strong>
          The automated workflow consistently meets creative expectations before scale.
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Brand Safety</span>

        <div class="scorecard-detail">shipped to market</div>
        <div class="scorecard-proves">

      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Operational Efficiency</span>

        <div class="scorecard-proves">

          The transformation continues to deliver measurable operational value at scale.
        </div>

      <div class="scorecard-item">
        <span class="scorecard-category">Operational Independence</span>
        <span class="scorecard-target-label">TARGET</span>

        <div class="scorecard-detail">sustained operational independence</div>
        <div class="scorecard-proves">
          <strong>What This Proves</strong>
          The platform can expand without requiring proportional engineering support for every brand.
        </div>

    </div>

    <div class="scale-decision">
      <p class="decision-main">Meet all four criteria &rarr; <span class="unlock-highlight">UNLOCK WAVE 2</span> (unlock the next wave).</p>
      <p class="decision-detail">Miss a threshold &rarr; remediate before expansion. Scale is earned by evidence, not assumed.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
